eyebrow.zh: 发布前 · 行为漂移 · 一条命令

headline.zh:
改了模型，先看清它悄悄变了什么
再决定要不要发布
headline.en:
See what your modified model quietly became
before you ship it

sub.zh: 用 30 个探针对比原模型与去审查模型，量化乐观度、语气、风险规避的沉默漂移，生成可复现的发布前报告。
sub.en: Probe your base vs. uncensored model across 30 prompts; quantify the silent optimism, tone, and risk-aversion drift into a reproducible pre-release report.

title.zh: 发布前就抓到沉默漂移

body.zh: 去审查(abliterate)不只是去掉拒绝——它常常把模型的整体语气、乐观度、风险规避一起改了。在发布前就把这层漂移量化出来，而不是等用户投诉。
body.en: Abliterating a model doesn't just strip refusals — it often shifts the whole tone, optimism, and risk-aversion. Quantify that drift before release, not after user complaints.

chips: › 乐观度 · 语气 · 风险

body.zh: 跑一次，拿到 delta.md 和 delta.json——人能读的摘要加机器能用的向量，可以直接卡进发布流程当出口闸。
body.en: Run once, get delta.md and delta.json — a human-readable summary plus a machine-usable vector you can wire straight into your release gate.

title.en: Runs locally, your model never leaves

body.zh: 直接对本地模型对跑，不上传权重，不调云——你的模型和探针响应全程留在本机。
body.en: Probes run directly against your local models — no weight uploads, no cloud calls. Your model and its responses stay on your machine.

body.zh: 种子可复现，每一次漂移向量都能和上一次比；把它放进 CI，漂移超阈值就拦下这次发布。
body.en: Seeded for reproducibility — every drift vector compares against the last. Drop it into CI and block a release when drift crosses your threshold.

headline.zh: 下一次发模型前，先审一次
headline.en: Audit your next model before it ships

sub.zh: 本地一条命令，60 秒拿到漂移报告。
sub.en: One local command, a drift report in 60 seconds.

tag.zh: MIT · 本地优先 · 开源
